description: The 77 policy table fields and their hash, acc = 0 then acc = Poseidon(acc, fields[11c..11c + 11]) for c = 0..7. Fields are CRTB, the version, list id and registry field per source slot, the rule, inline and limit counts, 16 rule rows, 8 inline assets, 8 inline limits, then asset, cap and cosign per limit row, every slot past a count zero. rule_parts splits each rule row read as one big-endian field from its low byte, subject, mode, mask and guard one byte each, the u64 threshold, then the alternative mask, every higher byte zero. Subject output_owner is 1, sender 2, asset 4, mode present 1, absent 2, guard always 0, above_amount 1, above_amount_by_asset 2, mask bit i is list i + 1. Produced by custom-rings/policy/tests/policy_table_vector.rs.
